preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^9) and k (1 ≤ k ≤ 10^5), representing the total number of problems and the number of training days, respectively.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.split()) == 2 and all(int(x) > 0 for x in stdout.split()[1].split()))
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output is exactly 'NO'. Otherwise, output is 'YES' followed by a space-separated list of k positive integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₖ representing the number of problems solved each day.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and sum(int(x) for x in stdout.split()[1].split()) == int(stdin.split()[0])
postconditions.description: The sum of the sequence a₁, a₂, ..., aₖ equals the total number of problems n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(int(stdout.split()[1].split()[i]) < int(stdout.split()[1].split()[i+1]) <= 2 * int(stdout.split()[1].split()[i]) for i in range(len(stdout.split()[1].split()) - 1))
postconditions.description: For each day i (1 ≤ i < k), the number of problems solved on day i+1 (a_{i+1}) satisfies a_i < a_{i+1} ≤ 2 * a_i.
